item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
A US-brokered ceasefire now covers Oleshky and has been extended across the Kherson region, while local ceasefires are also in place in frontline cities. Russian forces attacked the Russian city of Lipetsk with a fire blamed on a Ukrainian strike, and Ukrainian forces recaptured territory, according to Zelenskiy. Putin held calls with leaders of Finland and Norway, discussed Russian history, and faced split opinions among European leaders, while talks about lifting sanctions on a Russian investment fund continued. A suspect in the Nord Stream sabotage was identified as operating under direct command of the Ukrainian army. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
